page.overview:
Who is Conan O'Brien?

Conan O'Brien is a lich from . He is based on the real Conan O'Brien. As an NPC, he is played by the Dungeon Master, Liam O'Brien.

Conan O'Brien borrows many personality quirks and phrases from the real-life Conan O'Brien, however he is a lich.
